subject: Sovereign Stack — Enterprise Governance Framework v0.3.0
title: Sovereign Stack — Enterprise Governance Framework

body.text: The P31 Sovereign Stack is 5 governed domains — design, monetization, justice, audit, and govern (the runtime itself) — composed under one enterprise constitution. Each domain declares its gates, ratchets, runbooks, and lessons in a machine-readable constitution; the runtime is the seam every domain conforms to.

body.value: All 6 contracts (forge, design, monetization, justice, govern, audit) pass compose.

body.claim: Every governed domain validates against the schema.
body.value: All 7 constitutions pass validation (govern + six domains).
body.replayCommand: for d in constitution.json domains/*/constitution.json; do node dist/cli.js validate "$d"; done

body.text: Every audit event is appended to a hash-chained Genesis block ledger. Each block carries blockNumber, ISO-8601 timestamp, eventType, payload, prevHash, and currentHash; SHA-256 over the canonical JSON. Reordering, deletion, and silent edits are detectable. The enterprise timeline is a mirror built by explicit reconciliation, never written to directly by a domain.

body.value: SHA-256 linked with block 0 anchored, reconciled into the enterprise timeline.

body.text: Every gate can prove it can fail

A gate is furniture unless it can prove it can fail. Every gate carries a negative control: a fixture or mutation that must make the gate exit non-zero. The strong contract: the control must exit 0 and emit the literal marker NEGATIVE_CONTROL_OK. A gate whose negative control cannot prove it fails is removed from the enforcement surface.

body.claim: Gates are structural and self-tested in CI.
body.value: Every BLOCKING gate carries a negative control that proves it can fail; the self-test gate proves them in CI.
body.replayCommand: for d in constitution.json domains/*/constitution.json; do node dist/cli.js validate "$d"; done

body.text: Every blocking domain requires four distinct parties: user (consumes the guarantees), issuer (issues gates and contracts), ledger (records audit events), and court (independent arbitration). No single party can sever the domain.
design: K₄ four-party · monetization: K₄ four-party · justice: K₄ four-party · audit: K₄ four-party

The composer refuses a contract whose provider gate is not BLOCKING. Documentation says we do X; the system cannot do otherwise. The inter-domain contracts currently enforced: forge, design, monetization, justice, govern.

body.value: The composer exits non-zero on any non-BLOCKING provider gate.

body.text: This framework discloses its boundaries rather than hiding them. The compliance mapping is an alignment analysis, not a certification; no external attestation has been issued. Boundary ledger: KNOWN_GAPS.md in the runtime package.
